purpose: One-shot, static, read-only pre-training binding validation for the P3 R0.1 A2-392 temporal student.
prohibited_operations: import or initialize an ML runtime
load or deserialize the A2 checkpoint
parse or open the sealed target bundle
required_bindings: R0.1 protocol, current Git commit, training module, clip P1 evaluator, and both test files SHA256
unique A2 selected checkpoint, training receipt, parent protocol, and parent result SHA256
frozen A2 disagreement cache, manifest, and producer SHA256
legacy P1 ancestry exclusion ledger and source roster SHA256
train, validation, and public holdout identity manifest SHA256
zero parent overlap among all three roles and with legacy P1
train and validation counts for all nine geometry transitions
nine class weights derived from train counts only
sealed target bundle bytes, aggregate coverage receipt, and coverage producer SHA256
holdout outcomes unopened and all runtime-state assertions false

manifest_rules.timestamps: strictly increasing real timestamp_ns with each gap at most 500000000 ns

post_ready_boundary: Training activation is a separate command and is forbidden unless the READY receipt exactly reproduces against the same Git commit and bindings.
